note: Four documented failures do not support a precision estimate. The check is whether the pipeline separates pre-failure windows from routine operation.
interpretation: Two training failures are far below what the supervised setup needs; the Moskollektor models train on tens of thousands of episodes.
The MetroPT leak signature lives in analog magnitudes, while the feature set describes event dynamics (rates, interarrival, state entropy, failure history).
Quantile bands fixed on the training period do not follow the drift of the unit operating point, so the excursion events stop marking the fault.
No further tuning was done: with four documented failures any threshold search would fit the answer rather than validate the method.
scope_conclusion: The pipeline requires many labelled episodes and a fault signature that is present in discrete state or alarm events. Both hold for the Moskollektor journal and neither holds for MetroPT-3, so the dataset does not serve as a transfer benchmark.
